pattern_rationale: LabTrak LIS is a legacy SQLite database with direct read-only SQL file access. It lacks an API or event messaging stream, making scheduled SQL polling the only suitable mechanism.

alternatives_considered.why_not: LabTrak LIS does not expose an HTTP REST or SOAP API interface.
The database does not produce real-time event feeds such as HL7 v2 or Kafka messages.
Data is stored directly in an active SQLite database rather than periodically dumped as flat export files.

sync.detail: Runs a SQL query every 15 minutes polling for new or modified records in LAB_RSLT.

field_map.transform: Build Identifier object with system 'http://hospital.example.org/mrn' and value set to MRN_NO string
Direct string map; omit if null or empty
Wrap non-empty string in single-element array; omit if null or empty
Format YYYYMMDD integer/text into date string 'YYYY-MM-DD'
Code mapping: 'F' -> 'final', 'P' -> 'preliminary', 'C' -> 'corrected'; default to 'registered' if unmapped or missing
Set coding array containing system 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' and code 'laboratory'
Join LAB_RSLT to TEST_REF on TEST_CD. Map system 'http://loinc.org', code LOINC_CD, display TEST_NM
Join LAB_RSLT to PT_MSTR on PT_ID. Set logical reference identifier system 'http://hospital.example.org/mrn' and value MRN_NO
Parse timestamp string YYYYMMDDHHMMSS and convert to ISO-8601 UTC string 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ'
Parse RSLT_VAL as numeric float for value. Map UOM to unit and code, with system 'http://unitsofmeasure.org'. Omit if RSLT_VAL is non-numeric string.
Code mapping: 'H' -> 'H', 'L' -> 'L', 'N' -> 'N' with system 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ObservationInterpretation'; omit if empty or unmapped

risks: COLL_DTTM and RSLT_DTTM timestamps lack explicit timezone indicators in SQLite; treating them as UTC could result in timezone shifts if the legacy server recorded local time.
RSLT_VAL is stored as text and may contain non-numeric or qualitative results (e.g., 'POSITIVE', 'SEE NOTE'), causing numeric conversion to fail for valueQuantity.
SQLite database locking during active polling could interfere with legacy write operations or cause read timeouts.
human_review_points: Confirm whether COLL_DTTM and RSLT_DTTM timestamps are logged in local hospital timezone or UTC.
Verify how non-numeric result strings in RSLT_VAL should be handled (e.g., fallback to valueString instead of valueQuantity).
Confirm if MRN_NO format in PT_MSTR requires zero-padding alignment to match enterprise MRN standards.
